kb.title: Refund policy
kb.body: Delivered orders can be refunded within 30 days of delivery. Orders not yet delivered can be cancelled instead. Refunds go to the original payment method in 5-7 business days.

kb.title: Shipping times
kb.body: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days after an order ships. Orders ship within 2 business days of purchase.

kb.title: Warranty
kb.body: All products carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Warranty claims are handled by a human agent.
